name: a2a-mod
description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code: Claude hands tasks to non-Claude worker agents over Agent2Agent and picks up their results. LAN mode: Claude Code sessions on the same network find each other and exchange messages and files.

layout.title: A2A layout
layout.description: full: cards, band and workers pane. pane: the workers pane only. minimal: the status line only.

animations.title: A2A animations
animations.description: Off: spinners, shimmer, bars and the wire draw one still frame.

tokens.title: Worker tokens
tokens.description: alias=token pairs separated by spaces, e.g. "w1=abc w2=def"

lan.title: LAN mode
lan.description: On: Claude Code sessions on this network find each other and exchange messages and files (open mode with no lanSecret: any host on the LAN can message this session). Off: no sockets, the mod behaves as upstream's.

lanSecret.title: LAN shared secret
lanSecret.description: LAN mode: empty for open mode (no authentication). Set the same secret (8+ characters) on every machine for secret mode: only sessions with it see and reach each other. 1-7 characters is refused.

lanName.title: LAN name
lanName.description: LAN mode: the name other sessions address this one by (lan:<name>). Empty: <hostname>/<folder>.

lanPeers.title: LAN static peers
lanPeers.description: LAN mode: other machines to reach by address, for networks that drop multicast (a firewall, a VPN, a router between wired and Wi-Fi). host[:port] separated by spaces, e.g. "192.168.0.131 mac-mini.local:41400". No port: 41400-41409 are tried. /a2a lan add does the same from a session.
